title: NOT 16 x 16
text: NOT 16 x 16. These are very pretty and I love that the design is printed on both sides. However, they are not 16" The biggest one is 15" square, and one of them is 14.5".  The zipper opening is small and I couldn't get my 16" pillows in them without risking breaking the zipper. I did manage to get one in there, and it was so stuffed it was hard as a rock. Sending back and getting the 18" size, which will probably be 17", so should work ok.
